title: Extract shared keystore ops into wp11_backend_keystore.c
description: flash_sign/verify/decrypt and fsdir_sign/verify/decrypt are byte-for-byte identical except symbol names and backend type tag checks. Extract into a single ks_sign/ks_verify/ks_decrypt in src/wp11_backend_keystore.c that accepts either WP11_BACKEND_USB_FLASH or WP11_BACKEND_FSDIR. Both backend files keep their exported ops struct but point function pointers at the shared implementation. Add wp11_backend_keystore.c to Makefile SRCS (always compiled when either backend is enabled). Remove ~200 LOC of duplicated code.
